mapping.name: J-build-identityDocuments-from-lambDocType-lambDocNum
mapping.description: Construye el contenedor canónico sciback:identityDocuments desde upeu:lambDocType (tipo LAMB) + upeu:lambDocNum (número doc raw). IIA exclusivo: LAMB inbound. taxId legacy eliminado como source (DT-5: rompe ciclo J/J2). strong: revalúa en cada recompute. MidPoint Book Cap.9 + eduPerson 202208 schacPersonalUniqueID.

script.code: def rawDocNum = lambDocNum != null ? basic.stringify(lambDocNum).trim() : ''; if (!rawDocNum) return null; rawDocNum = rawDocNum.replaceFirst(/^(CE:|PP:)/, ''); /* CANON_KEY 2026-06-02: lambDocNum lleva prefijo de tipo (CE:/PP:) como clave de correlacion type-aware; el numero del documento canonico va SIN prefijo */ def rawType = lambDocType != null ? basic.stringify(lambDocType).trim() : ''; def typeId = rawType != '' ? rawType : null; def INVALID_TYPES = ['0', '97', '98', '99'] as Set; if (typeId != null && INVALID_TYPES.contains(typeId)) { log.debug('Bloque J: tipo LAMB {} inválido para {} — skip identityDocuments', typeId, focus?.name); return null }; def docType = 'DNI'; def verifiedBy = 'RENIEC'; def countryIssue = 'PER'; switch (typeId) { case '1': docType = 'DNI'; verifiedBy = 'RENIEC'; countryIssue = 'PER'; break; case '24': docType = 'DNI'; verifiedBy = 'RENIEC'; countryIssue = 'PER'; break; case '4': docType = 'CE'; verifiedBy = 'MIGRACIONES'; countryIssue = 'PER'; break; case '6': docType = 'CE'; verifiedBy = 'MIGRACIONES'; countryIssue = 'PER'; break; case '31': docType = 'CE'; verifiedBy = 'MIGRACIONES'; countryIssue = 'PER'; break; case '7': docType = 'PASSPORT'; verifiedBy = 'MIGRACIONES'; countryIssue = ''; break; case '9': docType = 'PASSPORT'; verifiedBy = 'MIGRACIONES'; countryIssue = ''; break; case '22': docType = 'PTP'; verifiedBy = 'MIGRACIONES'; countryIssue = 'PER'; break; case '23': docType = 'CPP'; verifiedBy = 'MIGRACIONES'; countryIssue = 'PER'; break; default: if (typeId != null) { log.warn('Bloque J: ID_TIPODOCUMENTO desconocido "{}" para {} — asumiendo DNI', typeId, focus?.name) }; docType = 'DNI'; verifiedBy = 'RENIEC'; countryIssue = 'PER' }; def NS = 'urn:sciback:midpoint:person'; try { def factory = midpoint.prismContext.itemFactory(); def containerDef = midpoint.prismContext.schemaRegistry.findComplexTypeDefinitionByType(new javax.xml.namespace.QName(NS, 'IdentityDocumentType')); if (containerDef == null) { log.error('Bloque J: IdentityDocumentType no encontrado en registry — verifique schema sciback. user={}', focus?.name); return null }; def cv = factory.createContainerValue(); def setStr = { String localName, String value -> if (value == null || value == '') return; def qn = new javax.xml.namespace.QName(NS, localName); def propDef = containerDef.findPropertyDefinition(com.evolveum.midpoint.prism.path.ItemPath.create(qn)); if (propDef == null) { log.warn('Bloque J: propiedad {} no encontrada en IdentityDocumentType', localName); return }; def prop = factory.createProperty(qn, propDef); prop.setRealValue(value); cv.add(prop) }; setStr('type', docType); setStr('number', rawDocNum); setStr('primary', 'true'); setStr('verifiedBy', verifiedBy); /* E1 2026-11-09: verifiedAt solo si el nombre visible ES el del DNI (dataQualityStatus=reniec_name) */ if (docType == 'DNI') { def va = upeuNombreOficial.execute('resolver', [focus: focus, campo: 'verifiedAt']); if (va) setStr('verifiedAt', va.toString()) }; if (countryIssue) setStr('countryOfIssue', countryIssue); log.debug('Bloque J: identityDocuments construido type={} number={} verifiedBy={} para {}', docType, rawDocNum, verifiedBy, focus?.name); return cv } catch (Exception e) { log.error('Bloque J: error construyendo identityDocuments para {}: {}', focus?.name, e.message); return null }
